displayName: Beringia & Peopling of the Americas (-25,000 BP)
displayDescription:
PALEOLITHIC SCENARIO: The Bering Land Bridge & American Incursion (-25,000 BC)

Models isolation of Paleolithic populations on the Bering land bridge during the Last Glacial Maximum (LGM), followed by dispersal through the ice-free corridor and Pacific coastal route.
